content.json:
# Microsoft Purview Data Exfiltration Workbook

Workbook for correlating Microsoft Purview, OfficeActivity, DLP, AI activity, and suspected data exfiltration.

> Replace `{SubscriptionId}`, `{ResourceGroup}`, and `{WorkspaceName}` during deployment or select your Sentinel workspace when editing the workbook.

content.query:
PurviewDLP_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Events=count(), Users=dcount(UserPrincipalName_s), Files=dcount(FileName_s) by SensitivityLabel_s
| order by Events desc
content.title: Sensitive Data Exposure by Label

content.query:
let AIUsers =
    AIApp_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
    | summarize AIPromptCount=count(), AISessions=make_set(SessionId_s, 50) by UserPrincipalName_s;
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Operation in ("FileAccessed", "FileDownloaded", "FileSyncDownloadedFull", "AnonymousLinkCreated", "SharingSet")
| summarize FileEvents=count(), Operations=make_set(Operation, 50), Sites=make_set(Site_Url, 25)
    by UserPrincipalName_s = UserId, bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| join kind=inner AIUsers on UserPrincipalName_s
| where FileEvents > 100
| project TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName_s, FileEvents, Operations, Sites, AIPromptCount, AISessions
| order by FileEvents desc
content.title: AI-Assisted Data Exfiltration Candidates

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Workload in ("SharePoint", "OneDrive")
| where Operation in ("AnonymousLinkCreated", "SecureLinkCreated", "SharingSet", "AddedToSecureLink")
| summarize SharingEvents=count(), Files=make_set(SourceFileName, 50), Sites=make_set(Site_Url, 25) by UserId, Operation
| order by SharingEvents desc
content.title: External Sharing Activity

content.query:
PurviewDLP_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize DLPMatches=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), PolicyName_s
| order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: DLP Policy Matches Over Time
